summary: Comprehensive testing of GPS Mileage Tracker NEW features and AI Assistant voice input. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%) - log-drive start/end, trip update (all fields including start_address, end_address, classification, notes), classify endpoint, categories CRUD, export-csv. Frontend: All UI elements verified - Quick Trip section with Start Trip button, voice command button, CSV export button, Siri Shortcuts guide, trip edit modal with all fields (date, miles, purpose, addresses, classification, notes), AI Assistant mic button next to attach button.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend log-drive endpoint correctly uses OSRM for road distance and Nominatim for reverse geocoding
Trip update endpoint properly validates classification (business/personal) and recalculates tax deduction
Categories endpoint seeds default categories on first call (Resale Sourcing, Shipping/Post Office, Pickup/Delivery, Client Meeting)
Export CSV returns IRS-compliant format with all required columns (Date, Start Address, End Address, Miles, Purpose, Classification, Tax Deduction, Notes)
Frontend Quick Trip section has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Trip edit modal includes all required fields: date, start_address, end_address, miles, classification toggle, purpose dropdown, notes
AI Assistant has mic button (data-testid='ai-voice-btn') next to attach button for voice input
Voice confirmation audio feedback implemented in useSpeechRecognition hook using Web Audio API
